user.title: Add ASP-100 breezer
user.description: Enter the breezer's MAC address and the pairing token captured during onboarding. The device must already be on your Wi-Fi.

data.host: IP address (optional, leave blank for auto-discovery)

error.invalid_token: Token must be hexadecimal (16 bytes / 32 hex chars).
error.cannot_connect: Could not find or reach the device on the network.
error.auth_failed: The device rejected this token. Re-pair to get a fresh token.
